name: feedback-widget
requirement: Users can submit feedback text from the app. Store submissions in DynamoDB and email a weekly digest to the product team via SendGrid.
proposed_spec:
## Overview

A lightweight in-app feedback widget that allows any authenticated user to submit free-text feedback at any time. Submissions are persisted in DynamoDB. A scheduled weekly digest email is sent to the product team via SendGrid, summarising all new submissions received in the past 7 days.

---

## User stories

1. **Submit feedback** – As an authenticated user, I want to open a feedback widget and type a message, so that I can share thoughts or report issues without leaving the app.
2. **Confirmation** – As a user, I want to see a confirmation message after submitting, so that I know my feedback was received.
3. **Weekly digest** – As a product team member, I want to receive a weekly email digest of all feedback submitted in the last 7 days, so that I can review trends and individual comments without manually querying the database.

---

## Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then)

### Widget – Happy path
- **Given** I am an authenticated user  
  **When** I click the "Give Feedback" trigger button  
  **Then** a feedback modal/panel opens containing a text area and a "Submit" button.

- **Given** the feedback modal is open  
  **When** I enter between 1 and 1 000 characters and click "Submit"  
  **Then** the submission is saved to DynamoDB with my user ID, submission timestamp (UTC ISO-8601), feedback text, and a generated UUID as the primary key; and a success confirmation message ("Thanks for your feedback!") is displayed; and the modal closes (or clears) after 2 seconds.

### Widget – Validation & error states
- **Given** the feedback modal is open  
  **When** I click "Submit" with an empty text area  
  **Then** an inline validation error "Please enter some feedback before submitting." is shown and no API call is made.

- **Given** the feedback modal is open  
  **When** I enter more than 1 000 characters  
  **Then** a character-count warning appears and the "Submit" button is disabled until the text is within the limit.

- **Given** I submit valid feedback  
  **When** the API call fails (network error or 5xx)  
  **Then** an error message "Something went wrong. Please try again." is displayed and the user can retry without losing their text.

### Widget – Dismissal
- **Given** the feedback modal is open  
  **When** I click "Cancel", press Escape, or click outside the modal  
  **Then** the modal closes and no submission is made; if there is unsaved text, a browser-native "discard changes?" confirmation is shown first.

### Weekly digest
- **Given** it is 09:00 UTC on Monday (configurable)  
  **When** the scheduled job runs  
  **Then** all feedback items with a `createdAt` timestamp within the past 7 days are retrieved from DynamoDB, formatted into a digest email, and sent via SendGrid to the configured product-team distribution list.

- **Given** no feedback was submitted in the past 7 days  
  **When** the scheduled job runs  
  **Then** either no email is sent **or** a "No feedback received this week." summary email is sent (implementation choice; default: skip sending).

- **Given** the SendGrid API call fails  
  **When** the scheduled job encounters an error  
  **Then** the failure is logged with full error details and an alert/notification is raised to on-call engineering (e.g., CloudWatch alarm); the job does not crash silently.

---

## Screens

> No designs were provided. Assumptions below describe the expected UI.

### 1. Feedback trigger button
- Fixed-position button (bottom-right corner of every app page, z-index above content).
- Label: "Give Feedback" with an optional speech-bubble icon.
- Visible to all authenticated users; hidden on the login/signup screens.

### 2. Feedback modal
- Centred overlay modal with a semi-transparent backdrop.
- **Header:** "Share your feedback"
- **Body:**
  - `<textarea>` placeholder: "Tell us what's on your mind…"
  - Character counter: e.g., "0 / 1000" updating in real time; turns red at > 1 000 chars.
- **Footer:**
  - "Cancel" button (secondary style, left-aligned)
  - "Submit" button (primary style, right-aligned; disabled when text is empty or > 1 000 chars)
- Loading spinner replaces the Submit button while the API call is in flight.

### 3. Success state (inline, within modal)
- Replaces the form content with: ✓ icon + "Thanks for your feedback!"
- Modal auto-closes after 2 seconds.

### 4. Error state (inline, within modal)
- Red banner above the text area: "Something went wrong. Please try again."
- Text is preserved; Submit button re-enabled.

---

## API endpoints

| Name | Method | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /feedback` | POST | Accepts `{ text: string }` from an authenticated user; validates, generates UUID + timestamp, writes a new item to DynamoDB, returns `201 Created`. |
| `GET /feedback` | GET | Admin/internal endpoint to retrieve feedback items, with optional query params `from` and `to` (ISO-8601 dates) and `limit`/`cursor` for pagination. Used by ops/debugging; not exposed in the UI. |
| `POST /internal/feedback/digest` | POST | Internal endpoint (triggered by the scheduler) that queries DynamoDB for the past 7 days of feedback and dispatches the digest email via SendGrid. Returns `200` on success. |

---

## Out of scope

- **Feedback categories / tags** – Users cannot categorise their feedback (e.g., bug, feature request). May be addressed in a future iteration.
- **File / screenshot attachments** – Text-only submissions; no image or file upload.
- **Feedback management UI** – There is no admin dashboard for viewing, filtering, or actioning feedback within the app.
- **Real-time notifications** – No Slack, webhook, or push notifications on individual submissions; only the weekly digest.
- **User-facing feedback history** – Users cannot view their previously submitted feedback.
- **Unsubscribe / preference management** – The digest recipient list is a static config value; no self-service unsubscribe.
- **Sentiment analysis or ML processing** – Raw text is stored and emailed as-is.
- **Unauthenticated submissions** – Anonymous feedback is not supported in this iteration.
- **Two-way communication** – The product team cannot reply to feedback through the system.

---

## Open questions

1. **Digest schedule flexibility** – Should the send day/time (defaulted to Monday 09:00 UTC) be configurable via environment variable, or is it hardcoded for now?
2. **Recipient list management** – How is the product-team distribution list stored and updated? (Suggested: environment variable `DIGEST_RECIPIENTS` as a comma-separated list.)
3. **DynamoDB access pattern** – Will a single-table design with a GSI on `createdAt` suffice, or is there an existing table/schema the feedback items should conform to?
4. **Authentication token** – Should `POST /feedback` accept the same auth token used elsewhere in the app (e.g., JWT/Cognito), or does it require a separate API key?
5. **Character limit** – Is 1 000 characters the agreed maximum, or should the limit be higher (e.g., 2 000 or 5 000)?
6. **"No submissions" digest behaviour** – Confirmed default is to skip sending when there are no submissions? Or should a "no feedback this week" email still be sent to signal the job ran successfully?
